title: Computing Picard Schemes
summary: We present an algorithm to compute the torsion component $\mathrm{Pic}^τX$ of the Picard scheme of a smooth projective variety $X$ over a field $k$. Specifically, we describe $\mathrm{Pic}^τX$ as a closed subscheme of a projective space defined by explicit homogeneous polynomials. Furthermore, we compute the group scheme structure on $\mathrm{Pic}^τX$. As applications, we provide algorithms to compute various homological invariants.
